caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricate lace pattern composed of repeating floral and geometric motifs. The lace is rectangular in its overall shape but has a scalloped lower edge and slightly irregular sides. The pattern is highly detailed, showing interconnected flowers, leaves, and small netted sections, allowing the negative space to contribute to the composition. The color of the drawing is a very light gray or muted tone against an off-white, slightly yellowed background. The lace design covers most of the central area of the drawing, leaving a plain border of background visible around its perimeter. There is a small signature or inscription located below the main lace design, close to the bottom center of the image.
title: Lace Wedding Veil (Section of)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
